description: Bugsnag (SmartBear) crash/error monitoring SDK. Bugsnag.start() constructs the Client, installs a global uncaught-exception handler and begins session/error delivery; Exodus classifies it as a tracker. NOTE: the static facade delegates every call to getClient(), which throws IllegalStateException before start() — so all app-callable void/primitive delegators are stubbed to prevent that throw once start() is neutralized.

methods.name: start
methods.note: Init. Returns com.bugsnag.android.Client. Stubbed to null so the Client is never constructed -> no uncaught-exception handler, no session/error delivery. Residual risk: apps that chain on the returned Client, or call the protected object-getters below, hit the not-started path (see report).

methods.name: notify
methods.note: void — manual error report. Stubbed so it no-ops instead of delegating to getClient() (which would throw when not started).

methods.name: setGroupingDiscriminator
methods.note: Returns java.lang.String (previous value). Delegates to getClient(); stubbed to avoid the not-started throw. Return value rarely used.

methods.name: addOnError
methods.note: void — registers a callback; delegator to getClient().

manifest_components.note: Auto-registered ContentProvider (Bugsnag 6.x+) that gathers process/app-start info early. Disable for hygiene; absent in 5.x (disable is best-effort / no-op when not present).

protected_patterns.reason: Returns com.bugsnag.android.Client the app may dereference; must not be nulled. (Note: with start() stubbed the real impl throws IllegalStateException — apps should guard with isStarted(); see report.)
Must stay real: returns false when not started (reads the static client field, never throws), so isStarted()-guarded code correctly skips getClient().
Returns com.bugsnag.android.User the app may read; do not null.
Returns java.lang.String context the app may read.
Returns java.lang.String the app may read.
Returns a List the app may iterate; null would NPE.
Returns a Map/Object the app may read; null could break app logic.
Returns com.bugsnag.android.LastRunInfo the app reads to detect a prior crash; do not null.
Returns a handler object the app may hold; do not null.
